##### Project general facts

Azizi Arian by Azizi Developments is a modern high-rise residential tower with a striking wave-like facade, where staggered balconies create a dynamic rippling effect that reflects the energy of the surrounding business hub. Smooth white curves, glass balustrades and warm louvres are softened by lush greenery cascading from above. The tower rises above three basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine and five podium levels to seventeen residential floors and a roof.

The collection offers contemporary studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, together with premium retail units at street level. Residents enjoy swimming pools with a children's pool and a poolside terrace, a fully equipped gym and a cinema, while a clubhouse, a lounge, a billiards area, social and recreation zones and a children's play area add variety, complemented by covered parking, lifts and round-the-clock security with video surveillance.

Every residence stands out for its thoughtful layout, stylish interiors and high-quality finishes, with balconies and large windows that bring natural light into the living spaces. Efficient floor plans suit professionals, couples and families who value a practical home close to work. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is one of the leading business and logistics hubs of Dubai, home to Jebel Ali Port, the largest port in the Middle East, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, where thousands of international companies are based. Residential neighbourhoods, community retail, cafes, schools and clinics sit close to the business district, giving residents a practical setting close to their workplaces.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Dubai Metro Red Line serves the area. Ibn Battuta Mall is a short drive away, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence are close by, and Expo City Dubai, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Palm Jebel Ali and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jebel Ali offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in western Dubai. A large working population in the free zone and the port supports steady demand from tenants seeking homes close to their workplaces. Continued infrastructure investment around Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport underpins attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
